#### Description

<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->
test_container_checker test fails for swss, syncd and teamd on Chassis supervisor.

The testcase calls, 'systemctl stop <service>' adn expects the docker associated with service goes down and container_checker to report 'Expected docker not running'.

container_checker process does not report the 'Expected docker not running' message for swss, syncd and teamd on Supervisor and the test cases fail.

Root cause:
The test case runs for all features and shuts down pmon service before swss/syncd/teamd. When pmon docker goes down, the CHASSIS_FABRIC_ASIC_TABLE entries also gets deleted.
The testcase does not start the pmon before running the test for next service.

When swss, syncd or teamd is tested and the service is stopped. The docker goes down. At this point container_checker script chcks for expected docker state. The container_cheaker depends on CHASSIS_FABRIC_ASIC_TABLE to provide the available asic list to calsulate the expected dockers but as pmon is down and the table is cleared from chassis db, asic information is not present. Due to this, container_checker does not include the swss, syncd, teamd services in the expected docker list and fails to report the error.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Run container_checker/test_container_checker.py on Supervisor
2.
3.

#### Describe the results you received:
container_checker failed to report the 'Expected docker not running' error for swss, syncd, and teamd

#### Describe the results you expected:
container_checker should report these containers down after systemctl stop <service>

linkedPullRequests.title: Fixed chassis: test_container_checker failure for swss/syncd/teamd on multi-asic Supervisor - issue #13559
linkedPullRequests.author: prem-nokia
linkedPullRequests.body:
#### Description
Code changes are implemented in deinit function such that it does not remove entries in CHASSI_FABRIC_ASIC_TABLE when supervisorctl stop chassisd is triggered.

#### Motivation and Context
fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/13559: The container_cheaker depends on CHASSIS_FABRIC_ASIC_TABLE to provide the available asic list to calculate the expected dockers but as pmon is down and the table is cleared from chassis db, asic information is not present. Due to this, container_checker does not include the swss, syncd, teamd services in the expected docker list and fails to report the error.

#### How Has This Been Tested?
1) Execute the below cmd.
```
admin@supervisor:~$docker exec pmon supervisorctl stop chassisd
chassisd: stopped
```
2) Look for the table entries using below cmd.
```
admin@supervisor:~$ sonic-db-dump -n CHASSIS_STATE_DB -y -k "CHASSIS*"
{
  "CHASSIS_FABRIC_ASIC_TABLE|asic6": {
    "expireat": 1677006173.948722,
    "ttl": -0.001,
    "type": "hash",
    "value": {
      "asic_id_in_module": "0",
      "asic_pci_address": "nokia-bdb:4:0",
      "name": "FABRIC-CARD3"
    }
  },
  "CHASSIS_FABRIC_ASIC_TABLE|asic7": {
    "expireat": 1677006173.9487307,
    "ttl": -0.001,
    "type": "hash",
    "value": {
      "asic_id_in_module": "1",
      "asic_pci_address": "nokia-bdb:4:1",
      "name": "FABRIC-CARD3"
    }
  }
}
```
#### Additional Information (Optional)

comments.author: mlok-nokia
comments.body:
> Please address the comment
> @mlok-nokia can you point to code where this happens? If i understand correctly issue was once we do de-init we were losing the entry and not getting repopulated

@rlhui @abdosi  The reply has been made last week.  Somehow it has been moved to the section before this comment. 
 --  Before this PR, these "FABRIC_ASIC" entries will be removed if stop chassisd or PMON (which trigger the de_init). The entries will be recreated when chassisd or PMON is restarted. Function module_updater.module_db_update() will recreate them. We have manaully test it. But, after this PR, these fabric entries will not be removed when PMON/chassis is stopped.

comments.author: prgeor
comments.body: @prem-nokia Instead of making this workaround the problem, can we make the test more intelligent? It doesn't look correct to NOT delete the DB entries owned/created by PMON to be NOT deleted once PMON is dead. In the test we can get the list of asics before PMON  is stopped and use that list after PMON is stopped.?
